ground_units.name: Gondor Soldier
ground_units.description: A disciplined soldier of Gondor, descendant of the Númenóreans. Forms the backbone of Gondor's defenses at Minas Tirith and Osgiliath.

variants.name: White Tower Guard
variants.specialty: Elite guards of Minas Tirith

variants.name: Harriers
variants.specialty: Light cavalry of Gondor

variants.name: Rangers of Ithilien
variants.specialty: Guerrilla warfare and scouting

ground_units.name: Ranger of the North
ground_units.description: Dúnedain rangers who patrol the northern lands, protecting the Shire and the remnants of Arnor. Masters of stealth and tracking.

variants.name: Aragorn (Strider)
variants.specialty: Heir of Isildur; master ranger and healer

variants.name: Halbarad
variants.specialty: Chieftain of the Rangers; fell at the Argonath

ground_units.name: Rider of Rohan
ground_units.description: A mounted warrior of Rohan, master of the fast transit ships and shock cavalry tactics. Charges into battle with horn and song.

variants.name: Éomer's Éored
variants.specialty: Elite cavalry detachment

variants.name: Shield-maidens
variants.specialty: Female warriors, including Éowyn

variants.name: Hornburg Garrison
variants.specialty: Defensive specialists

ground_units.name: Elven Archer
ground_units.description: An elven warrior with unmatched archery skills. Their arrows never miss and can pierce most armor. Serve in the hosts of Rivendell and Lothlórien.

variants.name: Lórien Archers
variants.specialty: Golden-helmeted archers of Galadhrim

variants.name: Rivendell Guards
variants.specialty: Elite defenders of Imladris

variants.name: Legolas Greenleaf
variants.specialty: Prince of Mirkwood; unmatched archer

ground_units.name: Dwarven Warrior
ground_units.description: A stout and resilient warrior of the Dwarves. Masters of close combat, axe-wielding, and defensive formations. Excel in underground and asteroid warfare.

variants.name: Gimli son of Glóin
variants.specialty: Lord of the Glittering Caves; Fellowship member

variants.name: Battle-dwarves
variants.specialty: Elite shock troops

variants.name: Guardians of the Gates
variants.specialty: Defenders of Moria's entrances

ground_units.name: Orc Warrior
ground_units.description: A mass-produced soldier of Mordor. Cruel, disciplined, and numerous. Forms the backbone of Sauron's armies.

variants.name: Orc Archers
variants.specialty: Ranged orc warriors

variants.name: Orc Berserkers
variants.specialty: Frenzied close-combat orcs

variants.name: Orc Engineers
variants.specialty: Siege weapon operators

ground_units.name: Uruk-hai
ground_units.description: Saruman's improved orc-line — larger, stronger, and capable of enduring sunlight. The elite infantry of Isengard.

variants.name: Uglúk
variants.specialty: Uruk-hai captain; led the force that captured Merry and Pippin

variants.name: Háma
variants.specialty: Elite Uruk-hai guard

ground_units.name: Ent
ground_units.description: An ancient tree-shepherd, immensely powerful and slow. Can uproot trees, destroy fortifications, and march through any terrain. Nearly indestructible.

variants.name: Treebeard
variants.specialty: Oldest Ent; leader of the Entmoot

variants.name: Huorns
variants.specialty: Mindless tree-creatures; swarm enemies

ground_units.name: Troll
ground_units.description: A giant creature of stone and malice. Used as a siege weapon and shock troop. Turns to stone in sunlight (unless enhanced).

variants.name: Hill Troll
variants.specialty: Standard troll; turns to stone in sunlight

variants.name: Stone Troll
variants.specialty: Larger and more durable

variants.name: Drake
variants.specialty: Fire-breathing dragon-troll hybrid

ground_units.name: Haradrim Warrior
ground_units.description: A warrior from the southern lands of Harad. Fierce and exotic, often fighting alongside Mûmakil.

variants.name: Mûman
variants.specialty: Elephant rider; fights from atop a Mûmakil

variants.name: White Hand Cultist
variants.specialty: Devoted servant of Sauron

ground_units.name: Mûmakil
ground_units.description: A massive war elephant from the South. Can crush fortifications and trample armies. Carries a howdah with Mûman riders.

variants.name: War Mûmakil
variants.specialty: Armored and battle-trained

variants.name: Beast Mûmakil
variants.specialty: Wild and unpredictable

ground_units.name: Corsair of Umbar
ground_units.description: A pirate warrior from the southern ports of Umbar. Skilled in naval combat and boarding actions, they threaten Gondor's coasts and trade routes.

variants.name: Captain of the Corsairs
variants.specialty: Leader of the Umbar pirate fleet

ground_units.name: Easterling Warrior
ground_units.description: A warrior from the eastern steppes of Rhûn. Nomadic and fierce, they fight alongside Mordor's forces or independently.

variants.name: Útúlië Rider
variants.specialty: Allies with Gondor; fights against Sauron

ground_units.name: Shelob
ground_units.description: A great spider, descendant of Ungoliant. Dwells in the passes of Cirith Ungol, ambushing travelers with venom and webs.

starships.name: Vingilot (Ship of Eärendil)
starships.description: The star-ship of Eärendil, bearing a Silmaril. Placed in the sky as a sign of hope, it serves as a galactic navigation beacon visible across light-years.

starships.name: Minas Tirith Fortress Station
starships.description: The great fortress world of Gondor, a multi-tiered orbital station with the White Tower at its center. The capital of the Free Peoples' human forces.

starships.name: Barad-dûr (Dark Tower)
starships.description: Sauron's dark fortress station, orbiting the lava world of Orodruin. The seat of the Dark Lord's power, it fell when the One Ring was destroyed.

starships.name: Helm's Deep (Hornburg)
starships.description: An impregnable fortress station in the mountains of Rohan. Withstood a massive assault by Saruman's forces, saved by an avalanche and the return of Éomer's riders.

starships.name: Orthanc Tower
starships.description: An indestructible tower of Adûnaic stone, one of the seven Palantíri. Saruman's seat of power within Isengard's factory complex.

starships.name: Rohan Cavalry Ship
starships.description: A fast transit ship used by the Riders of Rohan for rapid deployment and shock attacks. Equipped for cavalry-style boarding actions.

starships.name: Mordor War Ship
starships.description: A heavily armed warship of Mordor's fleet. Mass-produced in the forges of Barad-dûr, designed for overwhelming firepower.

starships.name: Fell Beast
starships.description: A massive flying creature, capable of space and atmospheric flight. Ridden by the Nazgûl, it inspires terror and dominates the skies.

variants.name: Witch-king's Fell Beast
variants.specialty: The largest and most powerful; fell at the Pelennor Fields

starships.name: Elven Ship
starships.description: A graceful elven vessel, built with unmatched craftsmanship. Used for exploration, diplomacy, and rapid response.

variants.name: Grey Havens Ship
variants.specialty: Can sail to Valinor through the Veil of the Stars

starships.name: Corsair Ship of Umbar
starships.description: A fast pirate vessel from the southern ports of Umbar. Used for raiding Gondor's coasts and disrupting trade routes. Fast and agile but lightly armored.

variants.name: Captain's Flagship
variants.specialty: Larger and better armed; commanded by the Captain of the Corsairs

starships.name: Gondor War Ship
starships.description: A powerful warship of Gondor's fleet, descended from the great ships of Númenor. Used to protect Gondor's coasts and project power across the seas.

variants.name: Aragorn's Flagship
variants.specialty: The King's ship; leads the fleet against the Corsairs

ground_vehicles.name: Warg
ground_vehicles.description: A giant wolf-like creature, intelligent and cruel. Used as a mount by orc warriors, particularly the Uruk-hai of Isengard.

variants.name: War Warg
variants.specialty: Larger and armored; used in the attack on Helm's Deep

ground_vehicles.name: Isengard Siege Engine
ground_vehicles.description: A massive mechanical weapon produced in Isengard's factories. Used to breach fortifications and crush enemy lines.

ground_vehicles.name: Rohan War Horse
ground_vehicles.description: A swift and loyal war horse of Rohan. The bond between rider and horse is legendary, with some horses (like Shadowfax) possessing near-magical speed.

variants.name: Shadowfax
variants.specialty: Lord of all horses; swiftest of living creatures; Gandalf's steed

characters.name: Gandalf the White
characters.description: The most powerful of the Istari, returned from the Dead as Gandalf the White after falling with the Balrog. Guide, strategist, and Maiar of immense power. Wields Narya, the Ring of Fire.

variants.name: Gandalf the Grey
variants.specialty: Earlier form; less powerful but more approachable

characters.name: Aragorn II (Strider)
characters.description: Heir of Isildur, rightful King of Gondor and Arnor. Master ranger, healer, and warrior. Wields Andúril, the reforged sword of Elendil.

variants.name: Strider
variants.specialty: Disguised ranger form; operates in the shadows

characters.name: Legolas Greenleaf
characters.description: Prince of Mirkwood, son of Thranduil. An elven archer of unmatched skill, his arrows never miss. Member of the Fellowship of the Ring.

characters.name: Gimli son of Glóin
characters.description: A dwarven warrior of Durin's folk, member of the Fellowship. Fierce in battle, with an unexpected friendship with Legolas. Later Lord of the Glittering Caves.

characters.name: Frodo Baggins
characters.description: The Ring-bearer, a hobbit of the Shire who volunteered to carry the One Ring to Mount Doom. His resilience and resistance to the Ring's corruption made him the only one who could succeed.

characters.name: Samwise Gamgee
characters.description: Frodo's loyal gardener and companion. The true hero of the War of the Ring, who carried Frodo and the Ring when Frodo could go no further. 'I will take the Ring, Mr. Frodo.'

characters.name: Boromir
characters.description: Son of Denethor, Captain of the White Tower. A proud and brave warrior of Gondor who fell to the temptation of the Ring but redeemed himself at the Battle of the Fellowship.

characters.name: Éowyn
characters.description: Shield-maiden of Rohan, niece of Théoden. Disguised as a man, she rode to the Battle of the Pelennor Fields and killed the Witch-king of Angmar. 'I am no man!'
abilities: Not by the Hand of Man

characters.name: Saruman the White
characters.description: Once the chief of the Istari, corrupted by the Palantír and the desire for the One Ring. Master of industry and technology, he built Isengard's war machine and bred the Uruk-hai.

characters.name: Witch-king of Angmar
characters.description: Captain of the Nazgûl, most powerful of the Nine Ringwraiths. Rides a Fell Beast and commands the forces of Mordor at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields. 'Not by the hand of man shall he fall.'

characters.name: Sauron, Dark Lord
characters.description: The Dark Lord, Maia of Aulë who fell to evil. Forged the One Ring to dominate all others. His spirit is bound to the Ring — its destruction ends his power. The Eye sees all.

variants.name: Sauron (Second Age)
variants.specialty: Fair form; deceived the Elves as Annatar

variants.name: The Eye
variants.specialty: Spirit form; cannot be directly fought

characters.name: Galadriel
characters.description: Lady of Lothlórien, bearer of Nenya (Ring of Water). One of the greatest Elves of the First Age, she has seen two of the Ages end. Her Mirror can see past, present, and possible futures.

characters.name: Elrond Half-elven
characters.description: Lord of Rivendell, bearer of Vilya (the most powerful of the Three Elven Rings). Half-elven, son of Eärendil. He chose the fate of the Elves and will eventually sail to Valinor.

characters.name: Treebeard
characters.description: The oldest Ent, shepherd of Fangorn Forest. Slow to speak and slower to act, but when roused to anger, he leads the Ents to destroy Isengard.

characters.name: Gollum (Sméagol)
characters.description: Once a hobbit-like creature named Sméagol, corrupted by the One Ring for over 500 years. Split personality between Gollum (evil) and Sméagol (good). His obsession with the Ring ultimately leads to its destruction.

variants.name: Sméagol
variants.specialty: The good side; occasionally helps Frodo

variants.name: Gollum
variants.specialty: The evil side; obsessed with the Precious

characters.name: Balrog of Moria
characters.description: A fallen Maia of fire, a demon of the ancient world. Awakened in the depths of Moria, it pursued the Fellowship and fell with Gandalf into the abyss.

characters.name: Thranduil
characters.description: King of the Wood-elves of Mirkwood, son of Orodreth. Proud and isolated, he rules from a golden hall beneath the trees. Reluctant to aid the wider world but a formidable warrior.

characters.name: Arwen Undómiel
characters.description: Daughter of Elrond, half-elven who chose the fate of Men. She gave up her place among the Immortal Lands to marry Aragorn. Her beauty and courage are legendary.

characters.name: Denethor II
characters.description: Steward of Gondor, proud and stubborn. Corrupted by the Palantír, he descends into despair. A capable commander but broken by the weight of his office and Sauron's influence.

characters.name: Éomer
characters.description: Éored-lord of the Éothéod, later King of Rohan. Fierce and loyal, he leads the Riders of Rohan with courage and skill. Returns to save Helm's Deep and fights at the Pelennor Fields.

characters.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
characters.description: A hobbit of the Shire, member of the Fellowship. Captured by Uruk-hai but rescued by the Ents. Later aids Éowyn in killing the Witch-king. 'I will take the Ring, Mr. Frodo.'

characters.name: Perian Took
characters.description: A hobbit of the Shire, member of the Fellowship. Impulsive and curious, he accidentally reveals the Fellowship in Moria. Later becomes a Guard of the Citadel and swears fealty to Aragorn.

characters.name: Bilbo Baggins
characters.description: A hobbit of the Shire, former Ring-bearer who found the One Ring in the depths of Gollum's home. Gave the Ring to Frodo and retired to Rivendell. Author of 'There and Back Again.'
